parameters.query:
UPDATE leads
SET
    status = 'completed',
    processed_at = NOW(),
    error_message = NULL,
    next_retry_at = NULL
WHERE lead_id = $1
  AND status = 'processing'
  AND sheets_saved = TRUE
  AND telegram_sent = TRUE
  AND execution_id = $2
RETURNING
    lead_id,
    status,
    sheets_saved,
    telegram_sent,
    processed_at;

UPDATE leads
SET sheets_saved = TRUE
WHERE lead_id = $1
  AND status = 'processing'
RETURNING lead_id, sheets_saved, status;

parameters.query:
SELECT
    lead_id,
    client_name,
    company,
    budget,
    request,
    sheets_saved,
    telegram_sent
FROM leads
WHERE lead_id = $1;

WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO leads (
        lead_id,
        client_name,
        company,
        budget,
        request,
        status,
        execution_id,
        processing_started_at
    )
    VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        'processing',
        $6,
        NOW()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (lead_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING lead_id
)
SELECT
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS is_new,
    $1::text AS lead_id;

UPDATE leads
SET
    status = 'processing',
    execution_id = $2,
    parent_execution_id = $3,
    processing_started_at = NOW(),
    next_retry_at = NULL,
    error_message = NULL,
    retry_count = COALESCE(retry_count, 0) + 1
WHERE lead_id = $1
  AND status = 'failed'
  AND COALESCE(retry_count, 0) < 3
  AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL
  AND next_retry_at <= NOW()
RETURNING
    lead_id,
    client_name,
    company,
    budget,
    request,
    retry_count,
    sheets_saved,
    telegram_sent;
